description: Business plans, strategy memos, GTM plans, investor decks, OKRs, and operational roadmaps.

brief_fields.description: Primary business objective this work must serve (e.g. enter new market, cut costs, raise Series A).
Key stakeholders or decision-makers the output is written for.
Known hard constraints: budget, headcount, regulatory, timeline.
Measurable success criteria (e.g. revenue target, churn rate, NPS).
